messages.subject: [Rpy] Find a new home for the main source repository
messages.subject_clean: [Rpy] Find a new home for the main source repository
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

Atlassian has announced the end of support for Mercurial repositories, so
rpy2 will have to find a new home for its main source repository:

https://bitbucket.org/rpy2/rpy2/issues/578


L.
